meta.description: Closed-loop rebuild of hound-jump.json, which needed two fixed-timestamp taps (880ms for the column-39 step, 1330ms to dodge the hound's tell before it commits) — a pairing the adversarial report (H3) found breaks the moment CP1's pace tuning changes when the player actually arrives, because the low route's window is one-to-two frames wide RELATIVE TO A MOVING ARRIVAL TIME. This script schedules zero timed jumps: 'pinned' clears whatever terrain is actually in the way whenever it actually jams, and 'houndTell' dodges the charge whenever the hound actually plants, regardless of build-specific timing. Same URL/enemies/window as hound-jump.json so the two are otherwise comparable.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against a hardcoded fixture snapshot, radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
